quest.guhs.vadsig.start: Guh... guhhh... NYEG! Those chonky Mikas have guhnapped my little Guhbert! Follow this Mika Tracker Compass to their camp and bring him back. Pretty please, wahoog hero!
quest.guhs.vadsig.camp: Nyeg, nyeg... The compass points to the Mika Camp. Defeat the Mika Boss and free my Guhbert! Chonk on!
quest.guhs.vadsig.cake: GUHBERT! Wahoog! But... NYEG, my cake for the welcome party is gone! Follow the cake crumbs to a Guh Picnic. And bring 3 guh balloons, or it's not a proper chonky party!
quest.guhs.vadsig.need: For the party I need the Lost Guh Cake (%s) and %s/%s guh balloons. You'll find balloons in picnic chests, or make them from pink wool and string. Nyeg, what a chonky party it's going to be!
quest.guhs.vadsig.party: WAHOOG CHONK! PAAAARTY! Thank you, thank you! Here, my belly whistle: from now on you have your very own guhbelly. Nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.vadsig.unlocked: Guhbelly unlocked! Blow the belly whistle or press G.
quest.guhs.vadsig.done: Guh guh! Guhbert and I are so chonky happy. Have fun in your belly, wahoog friend! Nyeg!
quest.guhs.cake.found: You found the Lost Guh Cake! Bring it to Mother Chonky with 3 guh balloons.
quest.guhs.guhbert.free: Guh! Guh guh! Wahoog! (Guhbert is free and follows you)
quest.guhs.dentist.no_maag: Open wide, nyeg! Oh, you don't have a belly yet. Ask Mother Chonky.
quest.guhs.dentist.max: Your belly is already %s wide. Any chonkier won't fit inside Mother Chonky, nyeg!
quest.guhs.dentist.job: Your belly is %s wide. For %s, bring me this, wahoog:
quest.guhs.dentist.done: Stretch... stretch... CHONK! Your belly is now %s wide.
quest.guhs.enzyme.not_yours: Blub. Nyeg. I only listen to %s.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.krampjes: Nyeg... hear that rumbling? Mother Chonky has tummy cramps from all those chonky snacks. If I stretch her belly a bit, you get more room and she gets less ouchie. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.dentist.done.krampjes: Stretch... CHONK! The cramps are gone and your belly is now %s wide. Mother Chonky sighs happily.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.mika: Nyeg! There's a Mika smell in her belly... A Big Mika once snatched her favorite plushie, and now she's too nervous to eat properly. Defeat a Big Mika, then I can stretch some more.
quest.guhs.dentist.done.mika: That Mika smell is gone, wahoog! Mother Chonky dares to munch again: your belly is now %s wide.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.goud: Mother Chonky misses her golden nephew... A Golden Guh coming to visit would make her so happy her belly would grow even more. Bring one along (tamed, nearby).
quest.guhs.dentist.done.goud: GOLD! She's so chonky happy her belly just grows: your belly is now %s wide.
quest.guhs.dentist.story.zacht: Her belly wall has gone a bit stiff, nyeg. Guh slime and cheese honey will make it nice and soft and stretchy again.
quest.guhs.dentist.done.zacht: Soft as a pillow! Your belly is now %s wide. Wahoog chonk!
quest.guhs.dentist.story.bloesem: The last and biggest stretch, nyeg! Mother Chonky wants a blossom garden in her belly. Bring guh blossom saplings and crystals, and show me you know every kind of guh (Guhdex).
quest.guhs.dentist.done.bloesem: WAHOOG CHONK! Mother Chonky now has a whole garden in her belly: your belly is %s wide. It really can't get any bigger!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.0: Nyeg... what's tickling in my tummy? Oh, it's you!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.1: Hmm, I could go for some cheese nibbles... don't eat what's lying around in there, okay!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.2: Guh guh... *rumble rumble*... sorry, that was my tummy.
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.4: Not too much jumping, nyeg, it tickles!
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.5: Guhbert says hi! He's waving at my tummy.
quest.guhs.vadsig.belly.6: Sometimes I can feel you building... what are you making in there, something chonky?
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.vol_vuur: The barbecue is already blazing, nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.gestookt: Sssss... the barbecue under the cauldron is lit!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.saus_erin: Blub! A pot full of cheese broth. Now stir in an ingredient.
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.nog_even: Let it bubble a little longer...
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.leeg: The pot is empty. First a bucket of cheese sauce!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.eerst_ingredien: Just cheese broth? Stir in an ingredient first, chonk!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.eerst_saus: First put a bucket of cheese sauce in the pot!
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.al_brouwsel: There's already a brew bubbling in the pot.
quest.guhs.guhbrouwketel.koud: The barbecue is cold! Fire it up with grill skewer powder.
quest.guhs.knus.binnenkort: Nyeg, I'm not quite ready yet! Come back soon, I'll have something super cozy for you. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.start: Ahem! Welcome, welcome to Snuggledale! I'm Mayor Chonkworth. The Great Cozyfest is coming up... and NOTHING is ready! No cake, no tea, no garlands, nyeg! Will you help? Here's my list of six party chores. And watch out for the Crumb Mikas: they snatch everything!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.lijst: Look, this is what's still on the list. Bring everything here and I'll tick it off. Ahem, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.hoi: Ah, there you are again! How are the party chores going? Let's see what you've got.
quest.guhs.burgemeester.hoi_collega: Ahem! Fellow Snuggle Mayor! How lovely. How are the party chores going?
quest.guhs.burgemeester.dank: Oh, WAHOOG! Thank you! Another party chore off the list. The Cozyfest is going to be so cozy!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.niets: Nyeg, you don't have anything for the party yet. Check the list to see what's still needed.
quest.guhs.burgemeester.alles: It's all here! The cake, the tea, the hairdos, the garlands, the flowers and the lanterns! So... now it's time for... THE GREAT COZYFEST! Everyone to the party buffet! Bring your guhs!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.alles_seizoen: It's all here! Now let's celebrate the season party. Everyone to the buffet! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.klaar.0: What a party that was. My tummy is still full. Come back next season and we'll celebrate again!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.klaar.1: Ahem. As mayor, I must say: this is the coziest dale in the whole Guhmension. Thanks to you!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.klaar.2: Have you ever listened to Grandpa Guh at the campfire? He tells the most wonderful stories. Sometimes he falls asleep halfway through, nyeg.
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.lente: It's spring! Time for the spring party! I've put a few new party chores on my list. Will you help again?
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.zomer: It's summer! The summer party is coming, and I have another list. Sun hats on and let's get to work, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.herfst: It's fall! I have a few party chores for the fall party. Jumping into the leaf piles in between is allowed!
quest.guhs.burgemeester.seizoen.winter: It's winter! The winter party will be the coziest party of the year. Will you help with my list?
quest.guhs.burgemeester.teruggevonden: Ahem! I found your %s by the fountain. That Crumb Mika left it lying there. Ticked off!
quest.guhs.cocotje.vraag: DO YOU KNOW WHERE THEY ARE??????
quest.guhs.cocotje.optie.2: I can see them hanging on you, Coco
quest.guhs.cocotje.antwoord.1: Nyeg good luck. I'll chonk it out if u know something
quest.guhs.cocotje.antwoord.2: OH YEAH THEY HANG ON MY CHONK
quest.guhs.cocotje.lief.1: they still hang on my chonk. nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.knabbel: Nom, a cheese nibble! Thank you! But I can't come with you, I live here. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.pluisje.0: Hi! I'm Fluffy. My house has the fluffiest ears in all of Snuggledale. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.pluisje.1: Know what I love most? Jumping into a leaf pile. Wheeee! But you can only do that in the fall, nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.pluisje.2: My fur is so fluffy, sometimes I lose a bit of fluff. See them floating? Those are mine.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.knabbeltje: I'm Nibbles and I can smell cheese nibbles from waaay far away. Got one on you, by any chance? Nyeg?
My roof is yellow, just like a cheese nibble. So I wake up chonky every morning.
Those Crumb Mikas sometimes snatch our nibbles, nyeg! Then we're not wahoog enough.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.dikkie.0: Hello, I'm Chubbs. I'm not too chonky, you know. You can never be too chonky! Just not wahoog enough.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.dikkie.1: At the party buffet I'm always first. And last. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.dikkie.2: I have a chonkbag at the top of my house. I sink into it so nice and chonky...
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.mollie.0: Hi hi, I'm Molly! I'm a little shy... but you're welcome to stay a while.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.mollie.1: Shall we watch the fountain together? That big guh head spits water, hee hee.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.mollie.2: In spring I braid blossom wreaths by the planters. You try too, with three little flowers!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.sproetje.0: I'm Freckles, the smallest in the dale! But my ears are HUGE. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.sproetje.1: Grandpa Guh tells stories at the campfire in the evening. About Mikas and cheese nibbles. So exciting!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.sproetje.2: When I grow up I'm going to be mayor. Or a baker. Or both! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.bolletje.0: I'm Dumpling, I live next to the playground. Slide! Swing! Climbing dome! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.bolletje.1: In winter I build snowman guhs: two snow blocks, a little snowguh head on top, done!
quest.guhs.knuffeldal.bewoner.bolletje.2: Sometimes I get so tired from playing that I just fall asleep in the sand. Zzz... nyeg.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.hello: Good morning! I'm Baker Crusty. The Mikas snatched my cheese nibbles again, and now the guhs in the dale aren't WAHOOG enough anymore... Will you help me with the orders?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.hello.feest: The Great Cozyfest! The mayor wants a party cake, and I only bake that for a real baker. Show me what you've got!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.busy: Shh, baking in progress! Your turn soon.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.busy_you: You're baking! The customers are waiting, chonk!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.elsewhere: You're already baking somewhere else. One bakery at a time!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.broken: Nyeg... my bakery is all muddled, I can't find my ovens.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.shop: My little shop! I only sell the baker outfit here. Nom!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.go: Apron on, pawsies washed? Click a nibble oven to bake, and give the customer what they want. Ready...?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.go.feest: Apron on! First get %s points, then the party customer comes for the party cake. Ready...?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.invite1: Warm buns! Come help me bake?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.invite2: The customers can't wait... nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.invite3: Who wants to be a baker? Come talk to me!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.start: Here come the customers! Chonk chonk chonk!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.half: One minute left! Keep baking, little baker!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.ten: Ten seconds left! Quick quick quick!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.cheer.feest: Look, the party customer is here! Bake the PARTY CAKE: sweet dough, tart, pink icing!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.bar: %s points · %s s left · combo x%s · %s happy customers
quest.guhs.bakkerij.vol: Your pockets are full! Give some to the customers first.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.aangebrand: Burnt! Your combo is gone... nyeg.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.verkeerd: That's not what they ordered! Combo gone.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.gemist: A customer waited too long. Combo gone.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.feesttaart: Baker Crusty wraps up a real party cake for you: bring it to Mayor Chonkworth! Watch out for Crumb Mikas...
quest.guhs.bakkerij.done: Done! %s points, %s happy customers, %s baked perfectly, best combo %s.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.first: Your first time baking! Here, %s extra Bake Coins. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.end.super: What a baker! The whole dale is WAHOOG again. Coming back tomorrow?
quest.guhs.bakkerij.end.good: Nicely baked, chonk! The customers are munching away.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.end.ok: That went pretty well! Even faster next time, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.stopped: Baking stopped (%s points). The customers are going home.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.feestwens: I'm here for the %s! Sweet dough, tart, pink icing... for the Cozyfest!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.blij2: Nom nom, a %s! Now I'm WAHOOG again.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.blij3: Just what I wanted, a %s! Nyeg!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.blij4: A %s, all for me! How chonky sweet!
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.weg: I have to go home... maybe tomorrow, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bakkerij.klant.niet_jij: You're not my baker, nyeg. I'm waiting for Crusty's helper.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.hoi.0: Shh, shh... hello! The baby guhs are sleeping. Well, almost all of them. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.hoi.1: Welcome to the Snuggle Daycare! Will you help me? Baby guhs are very sweet, but also very crawly.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.hoi.2: Hi! Did you know baby guhs can never be too chonky? They just need to become WAHOOG. That's what I help them with.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.bezig: One moment please, I'm helping someone else with the baby guhs right now. Zzz... shh!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.bezig_jij: You're already busy! Look at the cradles: they show what the baby guhs want.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.geen_wiegjes: Nyeg, where did my cradles go? Without cradles we can't do anything.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.verzorgen: Look, three baby guhs are awake! Above their cradle you can see what they want: first a bottle, then a clean diaper, then tucking in with a blankie, and then a lullaby. Here, take this!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.verzorgen_feest: The Great Cozyfest! The baby guhs want to make party garlands. Give them paper first, then a bottle, a clean diaper, the blankie and a lullaby. Here, take this!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.liedje_vandaag: Today we're singing: %s. Right-click the cradle when the baby guh wants a music note.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.liedje_opnieuw: Almost! %s of the %s notes right. One more time, nice and calm... just right-click the cradle.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.liedje_geleerd: Ooooh, that sounded lovely! You now know the song %s. It's in your Guhdex (Cozy).
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.verzorgd: All three are asleep! Zzz... how cozy. Here, %s Pacifier Coins. Thank you!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.slingers: And look what the baby guhs made for the party: party garlands! Bring them to Mayor Chonkworth.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.terugbrengen: Oopsie, the baby guhs are waking up and crawling everywhere! Right-click a baby guh to pick it up and bring it back to an empty cradle. Quick, but gently!
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.eerste_spel: So good for a first time! Here are %s extra Pacifier Coins, as a welcome.
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.gestopt: Okay, then I'll put them back myself. Zzz...
quest.guhs.juf_knuffel.te_lang: Nyeg, it took so long that I tucked them in myself. Will you come back later?
quest.guhs.theeguh.hoi.0: Welcome to the Nibble Tea House, sweetie! A cup of tea? Or a whole tea party?
quest.guhs.theeguh.hoi.1: Oh, how snug that you're here. Did you bring your guhs? Then we'll set the table!
quest.guhs.theeguh.hoi.2: A guh is never too chonky for another cup of tea. Just maybe not wahoog enough! Hee hee.
quest.guhs.theeguh.bezig: There's a tea party going on right now, sweetie. Come back in a bit!
quest.guhs.theeguh.bezig_jij: Your tea party is on! Look above your guhs' cups to see what they want.
quest.guhs.theeguh.geen_tafel: Nyeg, where is my tea table? No table, no tea party.
quest.guhs.theeguh.geen_guhs: I don't see any tame guhs of yours! Bring them inside and we'll have a tea party.
quest.guhs.theeguh.start: Sit down and get comfy, everyone! (%s guests) Pour tea when someone wants tea, and serve something tasty when someone's peckish. Pastries from the Nibble Bakery are the very yummiest!
quest.guhs.theeguh.huisthee: Here, %s cups of nibble tea on the house. You can brew more tea in a teapot.
quest.guhs.theeguh.gezellig: What a snug table! Everyone is totally cozy. Come visit again soon, sweetie.
quest.guhs.theeguh.theemutsje: Since it was your first snug tea party: a tea cozy hat for your guh! I bet it looks adorable.
quest.guhs.theeguh.theeservies: For the Great Cozyfest? Then I'll lend you my very best party tea set. Bring it to Mayor Chonkworth, and watch out for Crumb Mikas!
quest.guhs.theeguh.bijna: It was quite cozy (%s of %s), but not really snug yet. More tea next time!
quest.guhs.theeguh.gestopt: Okay sweetie, then I'll clear away the cups. Until next time!
quest.guhs.kapper.hoi.0: Welcome to Snip & Chonk! A guh is never too chonky for a new hairdo... just sometimes not wahoog enough. Fancy a salon show?
quest.guhs.kapper.hoi.1: Curl curl! My customers are already waiting. Will you help me snip? The Mikas snatched my cheese nibbles, so I can use all the help I can get!
quest.guhs.kapper.hoi.2: Nyeg, so much fluff today! Grab the scissors and let's make something wahoog of it.
quest.guhs.kapper.bezig: You're still busy! Your customer is waiting, hurry up with those scissors!
quest.guhs.kapper.druk: Nyeg, the salon is taken! Watch for a bit, your turn is coming.
quest.guhs.kapper.schaar: Here, a pair of barber scissors. You can borrow them. Don't snip your own ears, guh!
quest.guhs.kapper.geen_stoel: Nyeg... where did my barber chair go? No chair, no show.
quest.guhs.kapper.niet_jouw_klant: That's not your customer! Nyeg, no cutting in line.
quest.guhs.kapper.uitleg: The salon show begins! %s customers sit in the chair one by one. Look carefully at the photo: that's the hairstyle and color they want. First wash 3x, then snip, then dye, and blow-drying finishes it off. The faster, the more points, and perfect hairdos in a row give a combo!
quest.guhs.kapper.uitleg_feest: The party salon show! %s party guests want a party hairdo for the Great Cozyfest. Get enough points and you'll get the Party Hairdo Kit for Mayor Chonkworth!
quest.guhs.kapper.weggelopen: You walked out of the salon: the show is over!
quest.guhs.kapper.klaar: The show is done! %s points, %s perfect hairdos for %s customers: %s Curl Coin(s).
quest.guhs.kapper.record_eerste: Your first record: %s points! Will you make the top 3 above the show chair? WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.kapper.eerste: Your first salon show! A little welcome gift: 4 Curl Coins. Nyeg, you snip so nicely!
quest.guhs.kapper.feest_gelukt: WAHOOG! What party hairdos! Here's the Party Hairdo Kit. Bring it to Mayor Chonkworth, quick!
quest.guhs.kapper.feest_bijna: Nyeg, almost! For the Party Hairdo Kit you need at least %s points. One more time?
quest.guhs.kapper.uitslag.njeg: Nyeg... nothing right, but the customer still says a sweet thank you. +%s point
quest.guhs.kapper.uitslag.te_laat: The customer still had to get to the Nibble Bakery... but waves a sweet goodbye.
quest.guhs.kapper.bar.foto_weg: The photo is put away! Do you remember?
quest.guhs.boerderij.hallo: Nyeg, hello there! I'm Farmer Haybale. Welcome to the Guh Farm! My lambs, chicks and cows only get happy when you pet, brush and feed them. And happy animals give the yummiest things: fluff wool, nibble eggs and cheese milk. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.boerderij.al_klaar: You've already done today's chore, sweetie. I'll have something for you again tomorrow! Feel free to peek in my little shop.
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt0: Nyeg, well done! Here, for you: cheese nibbles, nibble feed and a little bag of seeds. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt1: Chore done? Then you're the most wahoog farmhand in the Guhmension! A little reward for you.
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt2: Just look at those happy animals! You did that. Here, some nibbles and seeds for your garden.
quest.guhs.boerderij.bedankt3: Thank you! If only those Mikas would keep their paws off my cheese nibbles, we'd all be even more wahoog... Here, take this!
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.aaien: Nyeg, today I'd like you to pet %s animals. Just with your hand, gently on their little heads. It makes them so happy!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.aaien: A bit more petting: %s of %s animals petted. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.borstelen: Today's chore: brush %s animals with a guh brush. Fluffy = happy, everybody knows that!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.borstelen: Brush, brush! %s of %s done. Do you have a guh brush? I sell them, you know.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.voeren: Today: give %s animals nibble feed. From your hand, they love that the most. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.voeren: A bit more feeding: %s of %s animals have had nibble feed.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.voerbak: My feed troughs are empty, nyeg! Put nibble feed in them %s times, then the animals can eat on their own.
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.voerbak: The feed troughs: %s of %s scoops done. Right-click a feed trough with nibble feed!
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.wol: Can you bring me %s fluff wool? Happy guh lambs shed their wool by themselves. It's for the daycare, they knit blankies!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.wol: I'm still waiting for fluff wool: you have %s of %s on you.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.eieren: Bring me %s nibble eggs, sweetie. Happy nibble chicks lay them in the chicken nests. For the baker!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.eieren: Nibble eggs: %s of %s. Have you checked the chicken nests?
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.melk: Today I'd like %s bottles of cheese milk. A happy guh cow gives cheese milk when you hold an empty bottle up to her. Moo!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.melk: Cheese milk: %s of %s bottles. The guh cow has to be happy first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.boerderij.klus.oogst: Bring me %s things from your garden: nibble grain, tea herb or guh flowers. Home-grown is extra wahoog!
quest.guhs.boerderij.nog.oogst: Harvest from your garden: %s of %s. A watering can helps, and tame guhs help too!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.hallo: Oh! Visitors! Welcome to the Guh Observatory, I'm Professor Twinkle. Every night I watch the guh constellations: The Big Nibble, The Little Chonk, the Guh Ear... Come back tonight and look through a telescope. Connect the stars and you'll get wishing stars. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.knusfeest: Star lanterns for the Cozyfest? Nyeg, of course! Connect a constellation in a telescope tonight and I'll give you %s. Then the party will be just as pretty as the sky!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.regen: A STAR SHOWER! Quick, to the telescope! Now you can see the rare constellations: The Golden Guh, The Falling Nibble and The Guh Crown!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.nacht: It's dark, the stars are out! Look through a telescope and connect them. I'll keep your atlas up to date, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.nacht_moe: You've done enough stargazing for tonight. Go get some cozy sleep, they'll be back tomorrow night.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip0: Did you know there are twelve guh constellations? And during a star shower three more, very rare ones!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip1: You can hold a wishing star in your hand and make a wish. Just right-click. What do you wish for? Usually cheese nibbles, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip2: The Fleeing Mika: a Mika with a sack of stolen cheese nibbles. That's why the guhs are never wahoog enough! He runs and runs...
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip3: My dome is a guh head, see the ears? That's how I hear the little stars twinkle.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip4: For wishing stars I have my stargazer hat and star cape in guh size. Your guh will look super starry!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip5: Your very own Guh Telescope? I'll trade you one for eight wishing stars. Then you can stargaze at home!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.tip6: During the day I sleep a little. Stargazers are wahoog at night and chonky by day. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.gevonden_nieuw: WAHOOG! You found %s! I'll write it in your Star Atlas. Here, %s wishing stars!
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.gevonden_weer: Ah, %s! You already knew that one, but it's still lovely. Here, %s wishing stars.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht.lantaarns: And for the Cozyfest: %s star lanterns! Bring them to the mayor.
quest.guhs.ballon.hallo: Ahoy, ground guh! Captain Cloudy here. I fly my Guh Hot-Air Balloon past the prettiest spots in the Guhmension. You don't have to steer, just look. After every flight you get a stamp. WAHOOG, all aboard!
quest.guhs.ballon.instappen: All aboard! Today we're flying %s. Keep your pawsies inside the basket, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ballon.al_in_de_lucht: My balloon is already in the air! Just wait a bit, it'll be back soon.
quest.guhs.ballon.geen_ballon: Oopsie, where did my balloon go? Without a balloon dock I can't get a new one either. Nyeg...
quest.guhs.ballon.winkel: My little shop! For Balloon Coins: a balloon cap, balloon goggles and mini hot-air balloons.
quest.guhs.ballon.landen: There's the balloon dock again. Gently landing... almost... FLOMP!
quest.guhs.ballon.geland: Landed! You'd already stamped these views, but they're still lovely, right? %2$s Balloon Coins for you.
quest.guhs.ballon.geland_stempels: Landed! %1$s new stamp(s) on your card (%3$s/%4$s) and %2$s Balloon Coins. WAHOOG flying!
quest.guhs.ballon.afgebroken: Oh dear, the flight was cut short. We're safely back down. Better luck next time, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.pluisjesronde: Burner on! We're flying the Fluff Loop: first over the flower field, then right through a cloud!
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.pluisjesronde: Feel how softly we're rising? Soft as a bit of fluff. That's why it's called the Fluff Loop.
Did you know the Mikas wanted a balloon too? But it was too heavy from all those stolen cheese nibbles. FLOMP!
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.hoge_vads: Burner on! Today it's the High Chonk: as high as a balloon can go. Don't look down... or do!
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.hoge_vads.0: Higher and higher... my ears are already flapping. Yours too?
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.hoge_vads.1: A real balloonist is never scared, just a little chonky. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.knabbelkring: Burner on! The Nibble Circle goes past the Giant Guh and a very special little cloud.
Look, down there the festival guhs are waving! Wave back!
This route is called the Nibble Circle because I always eat a cheese nibble along the way. *nibble*
quest.guhs.ballon.vertrek.zonnetjesroute: Burner on! The Sunshine Route: with a little hop and the prettiest view of them all.
quest.guhs.ballon.onderweg.zonnetjesrout: Smell that? Fresh air with a whiff of cheese sauce. Lovely.
Sometimes from up here I see Professor Twinkle waving, at his observatory in the mountains.
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.guhgezichtvel: Look down! There's a giant guh face made of flowers in the grass. From up here it's smiling at you, nyeg!
Here comes the flower field, just look down...
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.wolkenpoort: We're flying THROUGH a cloud! Everything's all white and soft, just like a guh cuddle. Pfff, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.wolkenpoort.k: Hold on tight, there's a big fat cloud right in front of us...
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.hoogste_puntj: Can't go any higher! This is the very top of the High Chonk. WAHOOG! See how tiny everything is down there?
Burner wide open... we're going even higher, and higher...
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.regenboogboch: Look to the side! A rainbow, just for us! That only happens when you fly wahoog enough.
Look to the side, here comes Rainbow Bend...
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.reuzenguh: There's the Giant Guh! A balloon so big it never gets fully blown up. Give a wave, he can see you!
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.reuzenguh.kom: Look down to the left, someone very big is lazing about down there...
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.hartjeswolkje: A little cloud shaped like a heart! That means someone's getting extra cuddles today. Maybe you!
I see something pink ahead of us... just wait...
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.brandersprong: BURNER WIDE OPEN! Hup, up we go! Tickles your tummy, right? WAHOOG!
Ready for a little hop? Hold on to your hat...
quest.guhs.ballon.uitzicht.guhmensie_uit: And now... hush for a moment. Look around you: the pink fields, the mountains, the sea far away. Isn't the Guhmension beautiful?
Just a little longer and you'll see the prettiest view of them all...
quest.guhs.kamperen.hallo: Hey, hello there, little one. I'm Grandpa Guh. In the daytime I take a nap, but in the evening I tell stories by the campfire. A different one every night. Will you come listen tonight? Bring a sleeping bag, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip0: Zzz... huh? Oh, it's still daytime. Come back tonight when the campfire is burning. Then I'll tell a story.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip1: You sleep just as well in a sleeping bag as in a bed. And you wake up very well-rested, honest.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip2: At night the guhs by the campfire put on their pajamas. So cute. I've got some myself too, shh.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip3: I know twelve stories. My grandpa knew thirteen, but he forgot the last one. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.tip4: Try sneaking up to me (sneak + talk): then I'll show you my sleeping bags and pajamas.
quest.guhs.kamperen.winkel: Have a look, little one. Sleeping bags, nightcaps and pajamas. For a few cheese nibbles, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.begin: Come closer, by the fire. Tonight's story is called: %s.
quest.guhs.kamperen.aanschuiven: Pull up a seat, little one. We've already started. Shh...
quest.guhs.kamperen.te_laat: Oh, you're late, little one! The story's almost over. You can listen in, but the cheese nibbles are for those who hear the whole story. Come back later for a new one, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.einde_half: And that was the story. You only heard the tail end, didn't you? Ask me for a whole story later, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow0: Mmm, do I smell a marshmallow nibble? Not too close to the fire, little one, or it'll turn black. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow1: In the old days we toasted cheese nibbles on a stick. Until the Mikas came to snatch them... Eat up quick!
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow2: Sticky snoot? That's part of a campfire. It makes you nice and WAHOOG, nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.marshmallow_sst: (Grandpa Guh sniffs, winks, and then quietly carries on...)
quest.guhs.kamperen.sst: Shh... just listen. The story isn't over yet.
quest.guhs.kamperen.morgen: One story per night, little one. Tomorrow I'll tell you a new one. Now off to sleep... zzz.
quest.guhs.kamperen.geen_vuur: Where did the campfire go? No campfire, no story, nyeg. Will you light one?
quest.guhs.kamperen.einde_nieuw: And that was the story. It's in your Story Collection now. Here, %s cheese nibbles to put under your pillow.
quest.guhs.kamperen.einde: And that was the story. You knew that one already, didn't you? Still lovely. Here, %s cheese nibbles.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.eerste_kaask: Long, long ago, when my grandpa was still a baby guh, there were no cheese nibbles at all.
The guhs ate grass. Just grass. They were sweet, but they were never, ever wahoog. Nyeg.
One night a star fell out of the sky. It rolled down the hill and came to rest in a little puddle of cheese sauce.
The next morning that star had turned crunchy and yellow, and it smelled... mmm... like cheese.
The littlest guh took a bite. And then another. And then he shouted: WAHOOG!
And so the very first cheese nibble was born. Ever since, all guhs search the sky for falling stars.
And that's why, little ones, a cheese nibble is really a little piece of starry sky. Night night... *yawn*
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.mika_die_nie: Do you know the Mikas? They're not really mean, you know. They just never learned to share.
The very first Mika found a sack of cheese nibbles. He had enough for a hundred guhs.
But instead of sharing, he hid them. In a cave. Under a rock. In his socks.
The guhs in the village went quiet and a bit floppy. They weren't wahoog enough, and that made them sad.
So the guhs went to the Mika, not angry, but with a cake. A homemade cake.
The Mika couldn't believe his eyes. Someone just giving something to HIM? He ran off giggling... without his nibbles.
Mikas still steal to this day, nyeg. But deep down inside, they just want a piece of cake too.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.groot_vadsfe: My grandpa's grandpa once threw the biggest party the Guhmension has ever seen.
There was a cake as tall as a tree, and cheese nibbles in every color of the rainbow.
But just as the party started... a Crumb Mika snatched the whole top layer of the cake! Crumbs everywhere!
Grandpa's grandpa didn't get angry. He followed the crumb trail, nice and calm, through the whole village.
At the end, the Crumb Mika was sitting under a bush, with cake on his nose. He was giggling nervously.
Grandpa's grandpa gave him a cheese nibble and said: 'Come along, there's enough for everyone.'
And so that year there was one more guest at the party. A bit crumbly, but very snug. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.pluk_niet_va: Once upon a time there was a little guh called Pip. Pip was small and a bit skinny, and he didn't like that.
No matter how hard he searched, every time he found a cheese nibble, a Mika snatched it away. Not wahoog again!
The other guhs never said he was too skinny, or too chonky, or too anything. Guhs don't say things like that.
Instead, they all went searching. Together. A long line of guhs, ears up, noses down.
And every nibble they found, they shared with Pip. Nom nom nom.
By the end of the week Pip was round and cheerful and totally, totally WAHOOG.
Remember, little ones: a guh is never too chonky. Sometimes he just needs a little help to become wahoog.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.0: Have you ever wondered why guhs have such big, round ears? Well, listen closely.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.1: Long ago, guhs had teeny tiny ears. So tiny they never heard a Mika sneaking up.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.2: So cheese nibbles kept disappearing. Nobody heard a thing. Tip-tip-tip... gone!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.3: Then the guhs decided that every evening, before bed, they would listen very carefully. To the wind. To the stars.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.4: And from all that listening, their ears grew bigger. And bigger. And rounder.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.5: Now guhs can hear a Mika from a hundred steps away. Even when he's tiptoeing. Even when he's whispering.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_oren.6: So if your ears tickle a little at night... they're growing just a tiny bit more. Shh, listen.
Far, far away, past the last guh villages, lies the Guh End. There, islands float in the sky.
And in the middle stands Nibble Mountain: a mountain of every cheese nibble the Mikas ever stole.
Some guhs say it reaches all the way to the stars. Others say it smells like fried cheese.
Only the bravest guhs go there. Not to fight, mind you. Guhs don't fight.
They go there to bring the nibbles back, so everyone at home can become wahoog again.
Maybe one day you'll go there too. Then bring enough cheese nibbles for the journey.
But not yet, okay? First, a good night's sleep. Nibble Mountain isn't going anywhere. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.grote_knabbe: Look up. See those stars there, shaped like a cheese nibble? That's The Big Nibble.
A long, long time ago there was a guh who loved cheese nibbles so much, he wanted to show them to everyone.
So he climbed the highest mountain, with the most beautiful nibble he had.
He held it up as high as he could and shouted: LOOK! WAHOOG!
The moon thought it was so pretty that she gently picked it up and placed it among the stars.
Now every guh can see it, every night. Professor Twinkle says it still smells a little bit like cheese.
If you ever find it through a telescope, make a wish. It always listens.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.wolkjes_eers: Captain Cloudy wasn't always a captain. He was just Cloudy, a little guh who loved watching clouds.
He wanted to fly so badly. He tried with an umbrella. FLOMP. With a bedsheet. FLOMP. With his ears. Double FLOMP.
Then he saw a soap bubble float away, and he thought: warm air goes up!
He sewed a balloon out of old guh socks, in the shape of his own head. Ears and all.
The first time he went up one block. The second time two. The third time... all the way above the clouds!
From up there he saw the whole Guhmension, and he cried a little, because it was so beautiful.
Ever since, he takes along everyone who wants to see it too. Maybe you tomorrow, nyeg!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.0: It doesn't happen often, but sometimes... sometimes it rains cheese nibbles. Honest!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.1: The first time it happened, nobody knew what was going on. Tick, tick, tick, on all the roofs.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.2: The guhs ran outside with their mouths open. Nom! Nom! Nom!
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.3: Even the Mikas came to look. They completely forgot to steal, they were so happy.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.4: That day everyone was wahoog at the same time. Guhs, Mikas, even the little bees.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.5: It was the snuggest day the Guhmension has ever known.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.kaasregen.6: So if you ever see a cheese shower: run outside, open your mouth, and share with whoever's next to you.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.verdwaalde_b: Once upon a time there was a baby guh who followed a butterfly. Very far. Much too far.
When he looked back, his family was gone. Only trees. Tall, dark giant guh trees.
He sat down on a rock and his little ears drooped. He didn't feel wahoog at all.
But do you know what he did then? He sang. A very soft guh song. Guh, guh, guh.
And far away, very far away, his mama heard that song, with her big round ears.
She found him, cuddled him, and together they snuggled into a warm guh nest that night.
So if you ever get lost, little one: just sing. There's always a guh listening.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.mika_met_gou: Not all Mikas keep stealing forever. This is the story of Mika Goldheart.
He was the best nibble thief of them all. He even stole nibbles from other Mikas' pockets.
One evening he saw a little guh crying, because all his nibbles were gone. Because of him.
Mika Goldheart got a funny feeling in his tummy. Not hunger. Something else.
That night he sneaked back and put all the nibbles in front of the door again. Plus a few extra.
The next morning the little guh was so wahoog that he hopped around all day. And Mika secretly watched and smiled.
Maybe every Mika has a little golden heart. You just have to let it shine a bit. Night night.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.0: This is my very favorite story. It's about this place, right here. Snuggledale.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.1: A long, long time ago this was a cold, bare valley. Nothing grew here, nobody lived here.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.2: Then an old guh came by, very tired from searching for cheese nibbles. He lay down and fell asleep.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.3: He dreamed of a place that was always soft and pink, where everyone cuddled each other, and nobody was ever alone.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.4: And because guh dreams sometimes come true, the next morning soft pink grass grew everywhere. And fluffy trees. And guhs.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.5: They built a little town, with a square and a fountain, and every year they celebrate the Great Cozyfest.
quest.guhs.kamperen.verhaal.knuffeldal.6: Who that old guh was? Hmm... maybe it was my grandpa. Or maybe... it was me. Night night, little ones. *snore*
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.hallo_n: Tooot! Welcome to the Snuggle Pool! I'm Lifeguard Bubbles. Here we wash guhs until they shine, and we have the three biggest slides in the whole Guhmension. Click a slide gate up top, hop in your swim ring and steer toward the rubber duckies. No running, but WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.hallo: Tooot! There you are again! Fancy a splash, or does a guh need a bath?
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.niet_re: TOOOOT! No running by the pool! We only slide on the slide, nyeg. Walk nice and chonky, like a real guh.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.winkel: Have a look around. Everything costs Ducky Coins: you earn those on the slides and by washing.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.wassen: Washing guhs goes like this: 1. guh shampoo on your tame guh at a washtub (then it hops in), 2. scrub with your hands until it's covered in suds, 3. rinse (click the tub), 4. blow-dry until it's dry. Then it shines for a whole day. So fluffy! Nyeg, not too chonky? Nope: never too chonky, just wahoog.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.cadeaut: Here, a bottle of guh shampoo and a hair dryer from me. For your first wash. Tooot!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip0: Steer left and right (A and D) toward the duckies. Grab a few in a row and you get a combo. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip1: In the funnels you get pushed outward against the wall. Steer inward for the duckies at the bottom!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip2: The Glow Tunnel is pitch dark, but the little stars glow. Keep a close eye out for the glow duckies and star duckies, nyeg.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip3: At the Big Splash you fly through the air at the end. The faster you go, the bigger the splash!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip4: A washed guh shines for a whole day. So clean and fluffy! You can never be too chonky, just not wahoog enough yet. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip5: The Mikas sometimes snatch cheese nibbles from the pool bags. Nyeg! Keep your stuff with you, and your guh will be wahoog enough.
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip6: There's a golden ducky. I've only seen it once myself. It was beautiful. *sniff*
quest.guhs.knuffelbad.badmeester.tip7: Hold sneak if you really want to get off the slide. But then you won't get any Ducky Coins, okay.
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.0: Ding-a-ling! Cheese ice creams! So cold they make you wahoog!
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.1: Nyeg, what a warm day! Fancy a cheese ice cream? One for your guh too?
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.2: The Mikas always want to snatch my ice creams. But I pedal faster! Ding-a-ling!
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.hallo.3: Give an ice cream to your guh: then it gets an ice cream hat. So cute, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ijscoguh.alsjeblieft: Here you go! Don't lick too fast, or you'll get cold ears.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.start: NEE-NAW NEE-NAW! Help, help! On the training ground next to the station, %s marshmallow campfires have flared up way too chonky! Here, take my guh fire hose: hold right-click and spray them all out. Quick, before the marshmallows burn!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.nog: %s fires left! Keep spraying (hold right-click), and they'll get smaller on their own. Pssst!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.allemaal_u: All out! Well done, colleague! But... DO YOU HEAR THAT? Squeak squeak! There's a little guh high up in the big tree on the training ground, and it's too scared to come down! Climb up the ladder and help it down.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.boom: The little guh is still in the tree! Climb the ladder and right-click the little guh, then it'll jump right into your arms.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.gered: Hup, into your arms and safe on the ground again! What a hero you are. Here, your very own fire helmet and fire coat: you're now a real firefighter guh! I'll take my hose back, it needs to dry in the hose tower.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bezet: Just a moment, there's already a firefighter guh putting out fires! Come back in a bit. Nee-naw!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.niks: Huh? I don't see any training ground here... Nyeg. Come find me at the fire station in Snuggledale.
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bedankt0: There's my best firefighter guh! Does the helmet suit you? Of course, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bedankt1: Not a single marshmallow fire too chonky today. Thanks to you, all the little guhs know how it's done!
quest.guhs.beroepen.brandweer.bedankt2: The little guh from the tree keeps asking about you. Now it only climbs very low bushes, hee hee.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.start: Alarm, alarm! The town's nibble vault is EMPTY! Someone snatched the whole nibble supply... And look: pink, chonky paw prints. That's a Mika, I'm sure of it. Follow the trail from the vault and find the nibbles! (Don't be scared: a Mika only giggles.)
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.volg: Follow the pink paw prints from the nibble vault! They sparkle a little, so they're easier to see.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.opgelost: You got the nibbles back! Case closed! The Nibble Thief ran off giggling, but oh well, he was just hungry. Here, your very own police cap and uniform: you're now a real police guh. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bezet: A detective is already on this case! Two sniffer noses on one trail just makes a mess. Come back in a bit.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.niks: Hmm, no vault and no trail to be seen here... Come find me at the little police station in Snuggledale.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bedankt0: Ha, my best detective! Not a single nibble snatched since you came along.
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bedankt1: The Nibble Thief came to say sorry this morning. He got a cuddle in the cuddle cell and a cheese nibble. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.beroepen.politie.bedankt2: That cap really suits you! You look like a real inspector. Wahoogsby is proud of you.
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.start: Achoo... oh no, that wasn't me, that was Sniffles! He's in the sick corner and he's sooo sniffly. I know a recipe: pick %s sniffle herbs in my herb garden behind the pharmacy, and mix them with cheese milk in the mixing cauldron by the window. Then give the remedy to Sniffles!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.kaasmelk: Here, a bottle of cheese milk from my little fridge. Don't drink it yourself, okay!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.kruidjes: You have %s of %s sniffle herbs. The rest grow in the herb garden and in the little greenhouse behind the pharmacy: right-click a big plant.
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.ketel: Enough sniffle herbs and cheese milk! Now right-click the mixing cauldron by the window. Blub blub...
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.geef: That smells so good! Give the remedy to Sniffles: right-click him with the remedy in your hand.
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.klaar: Sniffles is all better, can you hear him? No more achoo, just WAHOOG! Here, your very own doctor's coat and stethoscope. You're now a real pharmacist guh!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.bedankt0: Sniffles asks if you'll come play again. He hasn't sneezed in three days!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.bedankt1: Achoo... Oopsie, now I'm a bit sniffly myself. No worries, I know just the remedy!
quest.guhs.beroepen.apotheek.bedankt2: Listen with your stethoscope: that's the sound of a very wahoog little guh heart.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.start: Can we fix it? YES, WE CAN! ... Well, almost. My little house is nearly done, just the roof left. Bring me %s planks (any wood) for the roof beams and %s cheese nibbles for my lunch. Without lunch a builder never gets wahoog!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.nodig: I still need: planks %s/%s and cheese nibbles %s/%s. Come back when you have everything!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.materiaal: Lovely planks! And cheese nibbles, nom! Here are the roof tiles: %s of them. Climb the ladder onto the roof, walk up the little steps and right-click each see-through roof spot with a roof tile.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.nog: %s roof tiles to go! Right-click a see-through spot on top of the roof with a roof tile.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.af: TOPPING OUT! The roof is done! Can we fix it? YES, WE FIXED IT! Here, your very own hard hat and safety vest. You're now a real builder guh. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.gepikt: Oopsie... last night some Mikas climbed onto my roof and borrowed all the roof tiles, giggling. Nyeg! Back to square one.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.niks: Huh, where did my little house go? I only build in guh villages, you know.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.bedankt0: Look how pretty my little house is! Thanks to the best builder guh in the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.bedankt1: I'm already thinking about my next little house. With a slide off the roof, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beroepen.bouw.bedankt2: That hard hat really suits you! Now just a pencil behind your ear and you'll be just like me.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.hallo: Hi hi! I'm the Carpenter Guh. Tap tap, nyeg! See that half-built house? It's a guh house, shaped like a guh head. The walls are up, but the ear roof... I can't finish that on my own.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.uitleg: A guh house is a home for your tame guhs (and mousies and little turtles). They sleep in it, play nearby and do chores there. If you help me with this roof, I'll teach you how to build them yourself. In all three sizes!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.vraag: Yippee! For the roof I need %s planks (any wood) and %s pink wool: I'll make roof fluffs out of it. Will you bring them? Then we'll put the ear roof on together.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.nodig: Got the stuff yet? Planks: %s of %s. Pink wool: %s of %s. Any mix is fine, as long as they're planks. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.materiaal_heb: Ooh, I see %s planks and %s pink wool! Can I have them? Then I'll turn them into roof fluffs right away.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_uitleg: Tap tap tap... done! Here are %s roof fluffs. Climb up the scaffolding (the ladder by the site hut) and right-click each see-through spot on the roof with a roof fluff. Don't forget the ears!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.nieuw_dak: The last house is done... and a little guh family moved right in, nyeg! So we'll just put another roof on. Here are %s roof fluffs: climb up the scaffolding and right-click each see-through spot.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_nog: %s more spots, then the ear roof is on! Climb up the scaffolding and right-click the see-through spots with your roof fluffs. I'll hold the ladder, promise.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_af: TOPPING OUT! The ear roof is on, nyeg! You know what? This little house is for you: our very first house. Put it down at your home and let one of your guhs live in it. Then come and tell me!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.hint.bewoner: put the small Guh House down at your home, let one of your guhs live in it and tell the Carpenter Guh
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bewoner_nog: Is a guh living in your house yet? Put it down, right-click it and choose New Resident (or right-click it while carrying a guh). Then come and tell me, nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.klaar: A guh lives in our house! WAHOOG! You're now a real carpenter guh. Here: my building booklet (it has all three Guh Houses in it: small, medium and large), another little house as a gift and a little carpenter's helmet for your guh!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.knus_tip: Want to make the house even cozier? Put a toy (a slide, a seesaw, a swing, a tunnel or a nibble ball) and a guh lamp by your house, in the home area. Then I'll have something nice for you!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.knus_klaar: A toy and a guh lamp: how COZY! That makes your guhs so chonky happy. Here, my very own tool belt, with a little hammer and a folding ruler. Tap tap, nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.boekje_kwijt: Lost my building booklet? No worries, I've got another one. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bedankt0: Tap tap, nyeg! How are your houses doing? Still cozy?
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bedankt1: You know the best thing about a guh house? The ears. Always the ears. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.bedankt2: Building together is twice as chonky! Will you come help again? There's always a roof to do.
quest.guhs.timmerguh.niks: Tap tap... huh? My blueprint is missing, and I can't remember where the roof goes. Come back in a bit, nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.welkom: Aloha! I'm Lilo-guh. Have you ever surfed? No? Then I'll teach you! I'll lend you my board, and I'll surf right next to you. Ohana surfs together!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo1: Aloha, nyeg! The waves are WAHOOG today. Fancy a ride?
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo2: Look, here comes a set of waves! Grab your board, quick!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo3: Know what the secret is? Stay ahead of the foam. The foam is sweet, but it knocks you off your board.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.hallo4: I did three nibble spins this morning! Well, two. One was more of a splash.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.bezig: You're surfing! Hold sneak for a moment if you want to paddle back to the beach.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.geen_golv: Nyeg... I don't see any open water here. Where did the waves go?
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.uitleg: Surfing! Face the beach. A/D: along the beach. Wave coming? Paddle with W! On the wave: W down the wave (speed!), S up to the crest, space: jump at the crest. In the air: A/D spin, S grab your board. Stay ahead of the foam! To stop: hold sneak.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons1: Oopsie, SPLASH! No worries, climb back on. Ohana leaves no one behind!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons2: Nyeg, wet! That's part of it. Next wave!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons3: Hee hee, you looked like a cheese nibble in soup. One more time!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.plons4: Splashie! Even the best surf guhs take a dunk now and then.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.eerste: Your very first time surfing! Here: Seashell Coins and a surfboard rack for home. Aloha, wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.surf.uitslag: ≈ Surfing done: %s points (%s), +%s Seashell Coins. Waves ridden: %s, tricks: %s ≈
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.record_eerste: Your first score: %s points. Instantly your record, nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.welkom: Aloha! Want to dance? In hula you talk with your hips. I show you, you copy me, right on the beat of the music. Nyeg-nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo1: Aloha, nyeg! The ukulele is tuned, the flowers are ready. Shall we dance?
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo2: Hips left, hips right, and then... WAHOOG! It's that simple!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo3: My sister Nani-guh says I dance too much. But a guh can never dance too much!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.hallo4: A guh with a big quiff once sang this song on the beach. Everyone fainted. From happiness!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.bezig: You're dancing! Watch the steps sliding in, and press right on the beat.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.druk: %s is dancing with me right now. Watch along, and dance yourself in a bit!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.geen_mat: Nyeg... where's my flower mat? Without a mat I can't dance.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitleg.ma: Hula! The steps slide from the right to the flower. Press when they're on it: A hips left, D hips right. Slow and sweet, right on the beat!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitleg.me: Hula! Press when a step is on the flower: A hips left, D hips right, W arms up, S bend your knees. To the beat of the rock'n'roll!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitleg.la: Hula, fast! A left, D right, W arms up, S bend your knees, and at a golden star: space, WAHOOG! Half beats are coming too.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.weg: You stepped off the stage. The music stops... nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.uitslag: ✿ Hula done: %s points (%s), +%s Seashell Coins. WAHOOG! %s, Nyeg! %s, Guh. %s, miss %s, longest streak %s ✿
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.foutloos: NOT A SINGLE STEP MISSED! You're a real hula guh! It brings tears to my eyes. Happy tears!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar1: Beautifully danced! Your hips were totally wahoog.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar2: Aloha! Another song? Practice loosens up the hips.
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.klaar3: Hee hee, you dance just like my sister: with your tongue sticking out. Very impressive!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.hula.eerste: Your first hula! Here: Seashell Coins and two flower mats, to keep practicing at home. Aloha!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.blut: Aloha! No Seashell Coins? Go surfing or dancing with Lilo-guh, and you'll come back rich. Looking is always allowed!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo1: Aloha, nyeg! %s Seashell Coins? You can get lovely things for those!
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo2: Welcome to my little stall! Everything carved by hand. Well, by paw. (%s seashells in your pocket)
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo3: No, I'm not taking my mask off. A tiki is meant to be felt, not seen. (%s seashells)
quest.guhs.guhwaiispellen.tiki.hallo4: The little radio is my favorite. It plays the hula songs, at home too! (%s seashells)
Hi! I'm Tappy, the Carpenter Guh's little helper. I hold the nails. Well... most of the time. Nyeg.
Cheese first, then hammering! That's what the Carpenter Guh always says. That's why I'm sitting nice and chonky at the lunch table.
My little helmet is just as crooked as the Carpenter Guh's. One day I'll be a real carpenter guh too. Tap tap, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.timmerguh.dak_laatste: Only %s spots left? Those are so tricky to reach, I'll tap them in myself! Tap tap, poof!
